svg.title: Experiment 009 Stage-B paired CQER minus right-RHT excess NLL by frozen task order
svg.desc: In frozen task order, the paired CQER-32 minus right-RHT plus CQER-32 aligned excess NLL difference is positive on 27 tasks, zero on 0, and negative on 5. Positive values favor right-RHT. The mean improvement is 0.170815 nats per token; the paired 10,000-sample bootstrap 95 percent interval is 0.116082 to 0.229438. This is authenticated development evidence, not confirmation.
